apis.description: Ledger's APIs, by name, each with its Transport: what both apps hand their Platform

session.description: What one signed-in user gets: a collection for each kind of their money and the Backend's commands, on the signed APIs and the Std Sync the Platform hands it, and the hooks screens read it with

cache.description: What only this device has, belonging to no user: its Settings and their table

places.description: The Place order both apps follow, every Place with its address and Go Command, the stops a Thumb Lock picks, and what each Place shows, worked out once over the open session's money

commands.description: The vocabulary: every Command with its keys, the gesture that gives it on a touch screen, the guide to every gesture, and the sound and Key Bar of each as it is given

backend-device.description: The device Backend: every API's handlers on the device's own table and the Name Token resolver, loaded as a chunk of its own on the web and bundled on a phone

backend.description: The Backend, wherever it runs: the Ledger API's handlers on the services they need, each service with a cloud and a device version, imported from its own module

backend-handlers.description: Your logic: what each Ledger API call does, for the user who signed it, on the ledger table

backend-services.description: What the handlers stand on, one folder per service: its definition, and a cloud and a device version, each imported from its own file so a Worker loads only the cloud one and the app only the device one

services.description: Each version stands on its service's definition

api.description: The Ledger API both sides speak

model.description: The words of money, Accounts, Categories, Entries and the currency, with the sums over them

ledger-core.description: Read top-down: the Session over the named APIs, the device Backend, and the cache; the Backend answers the API in the words of the model. Commands stand alone; the Place order names them.
